claim: Puts an actual sun, moon or comet in the frame, which anchors light direction and time of day and usually takes over the composition it lands in. Twin_moons is the cheapest sentence in the system for saying this is not Earth.
method: identical subject sentence and seed in every panel; only the option clause changes. panels marked control render the untouched subject, because SDXL cannot express absence.

panels.clause: sun in frame, visible sun, sun disc
full moon, large moon in the sky
crescent moon, thin moon in the sky
comet, comet streaking across the sky, long tail
solar eclipse, black disc with corona, ring of light
two moons in the sky, twin moons
